clock_waveform.note: Command, address, and data are clocked on both edges of CK.

command_address_waveform.order: MSB byte first on the first rising edge after CS# low

latency_waveform.variable: 1x or 2x; RWDS driven during CA selects (asserted = 2x)

read_data_waveform.bus: DQ[7:0] at double data rate, one byte per edge
read_data_waveform.strobe: RWDS driven by the memory, edge-aligned with read data (source-synchronous capture)

write_data_waveform.bus: DQ[7:0] at double data rate, one byte per edge
write_data_waveform.mask: RWDS driven by the host as a byte data mask (high = mask, low = write)

transaction_waveform.burst: wrapped (16/32/64/128 B) / linear / hybrid; ends on CS# high

general_timing_rule: All command/address/data are referenced to CK edges at double data rate; read capture is referenced to the memory-driven RWDS strobe; the CA-to-data initial latency is set by CR0 (and the RWDS level during CA in variable mode). Peak throughput is 2 x 166 MHz x 1 byte = 333 MB/s.
